_doc: Every earlier release of agentive. Releases are commits (no tags yet): `ref` is the commit of the `Release vX.Y.Z` step, whose plugins/claude-code/agentive/payload is that release's repo layer + engine. To add a release: right after the release commit (`npm run version` = U3 release) add {"version": "<new X.Y.Z>", "ref": "<that commit sha>"} to the end of this list in the next commit. test_every_release_commit_is_listed fails (CI runs with full history) when a `Release v*` commit other than the current package.json version is missing here. docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md section 6 (upgrade_matrix).
